title: rc-live-6: uncertain hip / tibia (rc-live-5 wording) -> hip -> S$3,750 only

turns.user: Daniel slipped in the bathroom and broke a bone. The doctor thinks it is his hip but it could be his tibia; they are still checking. It is a closed fracture. What could his accident cover pay?
turns.visible:
The Group Insurance Benefits Booklet (page 7) pays the Simple Fracture as a percentage of the Simple Fracture Benefit Limit of S$5,000 for each listed case: Skull 100%; Hip 75%; Jaw, Pelvis, Leg, Ankle or Knee 50%; Arm, Wrist or Elbow 40%. The booklet’s listed cases group the leg together, so it does not distinguish the tibia from other leg bones. The booklet defines an accident as a sudden, unforeseen and involuntary event caused by external, violent and visible means.
Which listed case is Daniel’s fracture: hip, or jaw, pelvis, leg, ankle or knee?

turns.user: Update: the X-ray confirms it is his hip.
turns.visible:
If the Simple Fracture benefit applies to Daniel's case “Hip”, the conditional illustration is S$3,750: 75% of the Simple Fracture benefit limit of S$5,000, under the Group Insurance Benefits Booklet; it is an illustration from the document's terms, not a payment or an insurer's decision, and only for an injury the insurer accepts as caused by an accident (the policy says “We will pay the percentage of the Simple Fracture Benefit Limit shown below for a Simple Fracture of a nature listed, caused by an Accident”).
You told me the X-ray confirms it is his hip.

citations.excerpt: We will pay the percentage of the Simple Fracture Benefit Limit shown below for a Simple Fracture of a nature listed, caused by an Accident.

calculations.sentence: If the Simple Fracture benefit applies to Daniel's case “Hip”, the conditional illustration is S$3,750: 75% of the Simple Fracture benefit limit of S$5,000, under the Group Insurance Benefits Booklet; it is an illustration from the document's terms, not a payment or an insurer's decision, and only for an injury the insurer accepts as caused by an accident (the policy says “We will pay the percentage of the Simple Fracture Benefit Limit shown below for a Simple Fracture of a nature listed, caused by an Accident”).

conditions.text: Hip must meet Group Insurance Benefits Booklet’s own definition, confirmed by a reviewed medical decision.
conditions.needs: a reviewed decision that Daniel’s diagnosis meets Group Insurance Benefits Booklet’s definition of Hip (the insurer’s medical assessment)

calculations.unresolvedText: I worked out Daniel’s simple fracture under Group Insurance Benefits Booklet, but I couldn’t confirm the figure against your documents.
